column1: My friend, you know we bring you only the contracts worthy of your talents. So it is that I offer you this—and payment that you will find is more than fair.
column2: 我的朋友，你知道我们只会把配得上你才干的合约交给你。因此，我把这份合约和一笔你会认为相当公道的报酬交给你。

column1: Commander, I hope you are in good health. This contract may interest you—it fits your skills and the strengths of your company. With any luck, we'll both get what we want out of this job.
column2: 指挥官，希望你一切安好。这份合约或许适合你：既符合你的技能，也符合你们公司的实力。顺利的话，这次任务能让我们各取所需。

column1: I hope you're well, my friend. We in the Magistracy need your help once again. This contract may interest you—especially the bottom line. I think you'll find our conservation more than fair.
column2: 希望你一切安好，我的朋友。马里安霸权再次需要你的帮助。这份合约或许会让你感兴趣，尤其是报酬。我想你会觉得我们的条件十分公道。

column1: We both know the score, Commander. House Marik relies on you like you're one of our own, and you've always been happy to help us out. I hope you can see fit to agree this time as well—this is a job too important for lesser warriors.
column2: 指挥官，你我都清楚局势。马里克家族把你当作自家人一样倚重，而你也一直乐于相助。希望你这次也能答应——这项任务不是普通战士能够胜任的。

column1: I don't know why we bother offering you contracts, to be perfectly honest. It's obvious you're not a friend to the Marik-Stewart Commonwealth. Regardless, we find ourselves in desperate times, so we have to scrape the bottom of the barrel.
column2: 说实话，我不知道我们何必费心给你合约。显然，你不是马里克-斯图尔特联邦的朋友。尽管如此，我们眼下处境艰难，只能到桶底去刮渣了。

column1: Marik-Stewart Commonwealth has a use for mercenaries like you, Commander. I think you'll be interested in the attached contract. Hopefully we can come to a mutually beneficial agreement.
column2: 马里克-斯图尔特联邦用得上你这样的雇佣兵，指挥官。我想你会对随附的合约感兴趣。希望我们能达成互利协议。

column1: Marik-Stewart Commonwealth would like to offer you a choice contract, Commander. As the leader of a respected mercenary company, you should find the terms both fair and equitable, I think.
column2: 马里克-斯图尔特联邦想向你提供一份精选合约，指挥官。作为一支受尊敬的雇佣兵公司的首领，我想你会认为条款既公道又公平。

column1: Greetings, my friend. This contract is not one we would offer to a lesser mercenary, but you've proven your loyalty, prowess, and dedication to the ideals of the Marik-Stewart Commonwealth. I hope you'll accept our offer.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。这份合约不是我们会交给普通雇佣兵的，但你已经证明了自己对马里克-斯图尔特联邦理念的忠诚、实力与投入。希望你接受我们的提议。

column1: We both know the score, Commander. The Marik-Stewart Commonwealth relies on you like you're one of our own, and you've always been happy to help us out. I hope you can see fit to agree this time as well—this is a job too important for lesser warriors.
column2: 你我都清楚局势，指挥官。马里克-斯图尔特联邦把你当作自家人一样倚重，而你也一直乐于相助。希望你这次也能答应——这项任务不是普通战士能够胜任的。

column1: Commander, your constant skirmishes against the New Oberon Confederation are exhausting for both of us. Let us set aside hostilities and explore mutual opportunities for gain.
column2: 指挥官，你不断与新奥伯伦邦联交战，已经让我们双方都筋疲力尽。让我们放下敌意，探索共同获利的机会吧。

column1: Commander, the Confederation can match any offer from our rivals. Consider this contract and let us forge a beneficial partnership.
column2: 指挥官，邦联可以匹敌竞争对手的任何报价。考虑一下这份合约，让我们建立互利的合作关系。

column1: Your victories over us prove your capabilities, Commander. The New Oberon Confederation acknowledges your skill.  Take this contract, and let us work together rather than as adversaries.
column2: 你战胜我们的事实证明了你的能力，指挥官。新奥伯伦邦联认可你的实力。接下这份合约，让我们别再彼此为敌，携手合作吧。

column1: The restored government of the New Oberon Confederation seeks a mercenary outfit of your caliber for an important contract. Are you interested?
column2: 新奥伯伦邦联的复兴政府正在寻找像你们这样出色的雇佣兵公司来执行一项重要合约。你有兴趣吗？

column1: Your combat prowess continues to impress, Commander. Our mutual gains have been fruitful, and I have another contract for you that should enrich us both.
column2: 指挥官，你的战斗实力依旧令人印象深刻。我们共同获利，合作成果丰硕；我还有一份能让我们双方都受益的合约给你。

column1: Welcome back, Commander. The Confederation values our past collaborations and has another lucrative job lined up for you, one with significant spoils to claim.
column2: 欢迎回来，指挥官。邦联珍视我们过去的合作，又为你安排了一份利润丰厚、战利品可观的工作。

column1: Ahoy, Commander! Good to see you again. I've got a plum job that promises a hefty payday and plenty of spoils. Shall we set sail together once more?
column2: 嘿，指挥官！很高兴再次见到你。我这里有份上等活儿，报酬丰厚，战利品也少不了。我们再一次扬帆同行，如何？

column1: Excellent work, Commander! You handled the contract brilliantly, and your payment, let's call it 'loot', is already in your account.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官！你出色地完成了合约。你的报酬——姑且称作“战利品”吧——已经到账。

column1: That's not the level of determination the New Oberon Confederation expects, Commander. Partial payment is yours for what you achieved, but next time, complete the mission or face the consequences.
column2: 这可不是新奥伯伦邦联期待的决心，指挥官。你会获得已完成部分的报酬，但下次请完成任务，否则后果自负。

column1: Failure like this dishonors the agreement, Commander. Be thankful I'm sparing you further reprimand. Leave, and don't return unless you can uphold your word.
column2: 这样的失败有损协议，也有损你的信誉，指挥官。感谢我还愿意免去进一步斥责。离开吧，除非你能信守承诺，否则别回来。

column1: Commander, your constant fighting against the forces of the Oberon Confederation is draining on both of us.  Perhaps we could put aside our enmity and work together for mutual gain?
column2: 指挥官，你不断与奥伯伦邦联的部队交战，已经让我们双方都筋疲力尽。或许我们可以放下敌意，为共同利益合作？

column1: Commander, we can offer you contracts that match our rivals.  Please take up this contract and let us work together.
column2: 指挥官，我们能提供不逊于竞争对手的合约。请接下这份工作，让我们携手合作。

column1: The legitimate government of the Oberon Confederation have a contract for a mercenary group of your calibre, if you are interested.
column2: 奥伯伦邦联的合法政府有一份合约要交给像你们这样的雇佣兵公司，如果你有兴趣的话。

column1: You fight well Commander, and we've both benefited from our relationship in the past.  I have another contract for you, the loot from which will benefit us both.
column2: 你打得不错，指挥官，我们双方都曾从这段关系中获益。我还有一份合约给你，其中的战利品也会让我们双方受益。

column1: Ahoy Commander, it's good to see you again.  I've got another job for you, one where a good bit of loot to be had.
column2: 嘿，指挥官，很高兴再次见到你。我这里还有一份活儿，能捞到不少战利品。

column1: You'd never make it in the Oberon Confederation with that sort of cowardly attitude!  I'll partially pay you this time, but complete the damn contract next time, or else!
column2: 你这副胆小的德性，永远别想在奥伯伦邦联立足！这次我会付给你部分报酬，但下次要把该死的合约完成，否则后果自负！

column1: I should cut out your heart and enslave your entire crew for failing this simple task.  Leave, before I decide to do it!
column2: 你没完成这桩简单任务，我真该挖出你的心脏、奴役你的全体船员。滚吧，趁我还没决定这么做！

column1: I don't know why we bother offering you contracts, to be perfectly honest. It's obvious you're not a friend to the Oriente Protectorate. Regardless, we find ourselves in desperate times, so we have to scrape the bottom of the barrel.
column2: 说实话，我不知道我们何必费心给你合约。显然，你不是东方保护国的朋友。尽管如此，我们眼下处境艰难，只能到桶底去刮渣了。

column1: The Oriente Protectorate has a use for mercenaries like you, Commander. I think you'll be interested in the attached contract. Hopefully we can come to a mutually beneficial agreement.
column2: 东方保护国用得上你这样的雇佣兵，指挥官。我想你会对随附的合约感兴趣。希望我们能达成互利协议。

column1: The Oriente Protectorate would like to offer you a choice contract, Commander. As the leader of a respected mercenary company, you should find the terms both fair and equitable, I think.
column2: 东方保护国想向你提供一份精选合约，指挥官。作为一支受尊敬的雇佣兵公司的首领，我想你会认为条款既公道又公平。

column1: Commander, I hope this message finds you well. The people of the Oriente Protectorate would like to extend a contract to you, owing to our respect for your skills. Please consider it carefully.
column2: 指挥官，希望你收到这条消息时一切安好。东方保护国的人民想把这份合约交给你，这是出于我们对你能力的尊重。请仔细考虑。

column1: Greetings, my friend. This contract is not one we would offer to a lesser mercenary, but you've proven your loyalty, prowess, and dedication to the ideals of the Oriente Protectorate. I hope you'll accept our offer.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。这份合约不是我们会交给普通雇佣兵的，但你已经证明了自己对东方保护国理念的忠诚、实力与投入。希望你接受我们的提议。

column1: Commander, clearly we are at your mercy here, so I beg you to stop fighting us.  If you want money or salvage, I can offer you those with this contract.
column2: 指挥官，显然我们现在只能任你处置，所以求你别再与我们作战了。如果你想要钱或战利品，我可以通过这份合约给你。

column1: Please Commander, the Outworld Alliance desperately needs you to stop fighting against us.  I have been authorized to offer this contract in the hopes of a future together.
column2: 求你了，指挥官，外世界联盟迫切需要你停止与我们作战。我已获准向你提供这份合约，希望我们能共同迎来未来。

column1: Commander, the Outworld Alliance faces pressures from other factions, we would really appreciate you considering this contract to perform a task for us.
column2: 指挥官，外世界联盟正承受其他势力的压力。如果你愿意考虑接下这份任务，我们将不胜感激。

column1: The Outworld Alliance greets you Commander, and I can offer you this contract for your consideration.
column2: 外世界联盟向你问候，指挥官。我可以把这份合约交给你考虑。

column1: The Ragnarök Union sees you as nothing more than a mercenary outcast, undeserving of trust. If you wish to change that perception, begin by proving yourself useful with this simple task.
column2: 拉格纳洛克联盟只把你当作不值得信任的流亡雇佣兵。如果你想改变这种看法，就从用这项简单任务证明自己的价值开始。

column1: You have crossed the Ragnarök Union many times, Commander, and taken the lives of those under our banner. Let us put our history aside. Complete this task and you will be rewarded handsomely.
column2: 指挥官，你多次与拉格纳洛克联盟为敌，杀害了我们旗帜下的人。让我们把过去暂时放下。完成这项任务，你会得到丰厚报酬。

column1: Commander, your reputation as a warrior precedes you. The Ragnarök Union values strength, and we have a proposition that could benefit us both.
column2: 指挥官，你作为战士的名声早已传开。拉格纳洛克联盟重视力量，我有个能让我们双方受益的提议。

column1: Welcome, Commander. While the Ragnarök Union values its independence, we recognize the need for external support. There's a task that suits your skills perfectly.
column2: 欢迎，指挥官。拉格纳洛克联盟重视独立，但也承认需要外部支援。这里有项非常适合你技能的任务。

column1: Good to see you again, Commander. Our past collaborations have been fruitful, and I have another contract that could further our mutual benefit.
column2: 很高兴再次见到你，指挥官。我们过去的合作成果丰硕，我还有一份能进一步增进互利的合约给你。

column1: Greetings, my friend. Your skill in combat has greatly aided the Union before. I have another target that needs dealing with—your expertise will ensure success.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。你出色的战斗技能曾大大帮助过联盟。我还有一个目标需要处理——你的专长会确保任务成功。

column1: Come, Commander. Let us strategize about your next mission. Your valor brings honor to both you and the Union, and the rewards will match the effort.
column2: 来吧，指挥官。让我们谋划你的下一项任务。你的勇气为你和联盟带来荣誉，报酬也会与付出相称。

column1: Outstanding work, Commander. You've proven your worth to the Ragnarök Union, and payment is already on its way to your account.
column2: 出色的工作，指挥官。你证明了自己对拉格纳洛克联盟的价值，报酬已经在转入你的账户。

column1: Commander, this outcome is not what we hoped for, but you displayed courage in the effort. Partial payment is on the way—do better next time.
column2: 指挥官，这个结果并非我们所希望的，但你在行动中展现了勇气。部分报酬正在路上——下次做得更好。

column1: Your failure reflects poorly on both of us, Commander. We demand competency, and you've proven incapable. Leave before we consider stronger consequences.
column2: 你的失败让我们双方都蒙羞，指挥官。我们要求的是能力，而你已经证明自己做不到。趁我们还没考虑更严厉的后果，离开吧。

column1: The FRR was established as a peaceful neutral nation, however your constant attacks have placed our very existence in jeopardy.  I beg you to reverse this trend and take this contract to promote our mutual interests.
column2: 自由拉萨尔哈格共和国原本是和平中立的国家，但你不断发动攻击，已经把我们的生存置于危急关头。我恳请你扭转这一趋势，接下这份合约，促进双方共同利益。

column1: The Free Rasalhague Republic has been the target of your attacks on numerous occasions Commander.  If you seek simply profit, I can offer you a suitable contract that will provide the profits you seek.
column2: 自由拉萨尔哈格共和国曾多次成为你的攻击目标，指挥官。如果你只是想获利，我可以提供一份合适的合约，让你得到想要的收益。

column1: Commander, the FRR have faced you in combat before, and you are obviously a competent warrior.  I have a contract here for you, should you wish to profit from working with us, rather than against us.
column2: 指挥官，自由拉萨尔哈格共和国过去曾与你交战，而你显然是名合格的战士。如果你想与我们合作而非为敌，我这里有一份合约。

column1: The Free Rasalhague Republic welcomes you Commander.  I have a contract here that would suit someone of your ability if you are interested.
column2: 自由拉萨尔哈格共和国欢迎你，指挥官。我这里有一份适合你能力的合约，如果你有兴趣的话。

column1: Hello again Commander.  We have profited before from our dealings, and I hope to continue this by offering you this contract.
column2: 指挥官，又见面了。我们过去从交易中获益良多，希望通过把这份合约交给你继续获利。

column1: Welcome Commander.  The FRR appreciates your continued efforts on our behalf, and I have a particularly profitable task for you if you would like it?
column2: 欢迎，指挥官。自由拉萨尔哈格共和国感谢你一直以来的努力；如果你愿意，我这里有一项利润丰厚的任务。

column1: Hello my friend.  You have done so much for us that even Prince Magnusson sings your praises.  I have saved this task for you, as I feel you are uniquely capable of completing it.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。你为我们做了这么多，连马格努松亲王都在称赞你。我把这项任务留给你，因为我认为只有你最有能力完成它。

column1: On behalf of the FRR, I thank you for your services.  Full payment has been transferred to your nominated account.
column2: 我谨代表自由拉萨尔哈格共和国感谢你的效力。全额报酬已经转入你指定的账户。

column1: The FRR expects more of it's mercenaries Commander.  However, you did at least partially accomplish the objectives, so I have taken the liberty of making a partial payment of the contract.
column2: 自由拉萨尔哈格共和国对雇佣兵有更高要求，指挥官。不过你至少完成了部分目标，所以我自作主张，先支付这份合约的部分报酬。

column1: You have failed the FRR, and you have not upheld your part of the contract in any significant way.  I hope you don't expect payment for this fiasco.
column2: 你辜负了自由拉萨尔哈格共和国，也几乎没有履行合约中的责任。我希望你没打算为这场惨败索要报酬。

column1: Your insistence on opposing the Dominion has been noted, Commander. However, we offer you this mission to demonstrate your ability to work alongside us rather than against us.
column2: 指挥官，你坚持反对我们的自治领，这一点我们已经注意到了。不过，我们提供这项任务，是为了证明你也能与我们并肩，而非与我们为敌。

column1: You have an appetite for battle, Commander. Let this contract give you a chance to channel that hunger in service to the Dominion.
column2: 你渴望战斗，指挥官。这份合约可以让你把这股饥渴用在为自治领效力上。

column1: We have faced you before, Commander, and you have proven your skill as a warrior. Accept this contract, and we may yet find common ground in purpose.
column2: 我们曾与你交手，指挥官，你已经证明了自己是一名出色的战士。接受这份合约，也许我们还能找到共同目标。

column1: You are an unknown quantity to us, Commander. Prove your worth on this mission, and perhaps a fruitful relationship can begin.
column2: 指挥官，对我们而言你还是个未知数。在这项任务中证明自己的价值，也许我们能建立富有成果的关系。

column1: Your prior service to the Dominion has been appreciated. I offer you this mission to continue building upon our established trust.
column2: 你过去为自治领效力，表现值得肯定。我把这项任务交给你，继续巩固我们已经建立的信任。

column1: Greetings again, trusted ally of the Dominion. This mission represents the mutual respect and cooperation we have come to expect from one another.
column2: 自治领值得信赖的盟友，欢迎再次见面。我们彼此都已习惯这种相互尊重与合作，这项任务正体现了这一点。

column1: Greetings, my brother-in-arms. You have served the Dominion so faithfully that I see you as almost one of us. I entrust you with this key mission, knowing you will not falter.
column2: 你好，我的战友。你一直如此忠诚地为自治领效力，我几乎把你当成了我们的一员。我把这项关键任务托付给你，相信你不会失手。

column1: Your successful completion of this mission brings great benefit to the Dominion. The agreed-upon payment has been transferred in recognition of your effort.
column2: 成功完成这项任务将为自治领带来巨大收益。为表彰你的努力，约定的报酬已经转账。

column1: Though you fell short of completing all objectives, your effort has not gone unnoticed. A partial payment will be issued, but I expect better results next time.
column2: 虽然你没有完成所有目标，但你的努力并未被忽视。我们会支付部分报酬，不过我期待你下次取得更好的结果。

column1: Your failure is unworthy of a warrior's name, Commander. You have dishonored this agreement and earned only my disappointment and scorn.
column2: 你的失败配不上战士之名，指挥官。你玷污了这份协议，只赢得我的失望与鄙夷。

column1: The Raven Alliance has faced you in battle before.  Take up this batchall so we can mutually profit from a closer relationship.
column2: 乌鸦联盟曾与你并肩作战。接下这份战斗邀约，让我们通过更紧密的关系共同获利。

column1: You have assisted the Raven Alliance in the past.  Continue to be useful by taking up this batchall and we will offer you more profitable tasks.
column2: 你过去帮助过乌鸦联盟。继续接下这份战斗邀约、证明自己的价值，我们会为你提供更多利润丰厚的任务。

column1: Hello again, my mercenary friend.  I have saved this batchall especially for you, in recognition of your fine service in the past.
column2: 你好，我的雇佣兵朋友。我特意为你留着这份战斗邀约，以感谢你过去的出色效力。

column1: Commander, you can't expect to enter into a batchall and then fail to fulfill any of the conditions!  You will need to try much harder if you wish to have any further dealings with the Raven Alliance.
column2: 指挥官，你不能指望接下战斗邀约后却不履行任何条件！如果还想和乌鸦联盟打交道，你就得更加努力。

column1: I wish this enmity between us to go away so that we can offer you more exclusive batchalls.  Please take this so that we can move towards a more trusting relationship.
column2: 我希望我们之间的敌意能够消散，好让我们向你提供更多专属战斗邀约。请接下这份工作，让我们走向更值得信赖的关系。

column1: I don't know why we bother offering you contracts, to be perfectly honest. It's obvious you're not a friend to the Regulan Fiefs. Regardless, we find ourselves in desperate times, so we have to scrape the bottom of the barrel.
column2: 说实话，我不知道我们何必费心给你合约。显然，你不是雷古兰领地的朋友。尽管如此，我们眼下处境艰难，只能到桶底去刮渣了。

column1: The Regulan Fiefs has a use for mercenaries like you, Commander. I think you'll be interested in the attached contract. Hopefully we can come to a mutually beneficial agreement.
column2: 雷古兰领地用得上你这样的雇佣兵，指挥官。我想你会对随附的合约感兴趣。希望我们能达成互利协议。

column1: The Regulan Fiefs would like to offer you a choice contract, Commander. As the leader of a respected mercenary company, you should find the terms both fair and equitable, I think.
column2: 雷古兰领地想向你提供一份精选合约，指挥官。作为一支受尊敬的雇佣兵公司的首领，我想你会认为条款既公道又公平。

column1: Commander, I hope this message finds you well. The people of the Regulan Fiefs would like to extend a contract to you, owing to our respect for your skills. Please consider it carefully.
column2: 指挥官，希望你收到这条消息时一切安好。雷古兰领地的人民想把这份合约交给你，这是出于我们对你能力的尊重。请仔细考虑。

column1: We both know the score, Commander. House Cameron-Jones relies on you like you're one of our own, and you've always been happy to help us out. I hope you can see fit to agree this time as well—this is a job too important for lesser warriors.
column2: 你我都清楚局势，指挥官。卡梅隆-琼斯家族把你当作自家人一样倚重，而你也一直乐于相助。希望你这次也能答应——这项任务不是普通战士能够胜任的。

column1: Even if you only work for profit and salvage, you seem effective enough. The Republic has need of your skills, Commander.
column2: 即使你只是为了利润和战利品而战，你看起来也足够有效率。共和国需要你的本事，指挥官。

column1: The Council would like me to offer you a choice contract, Commander. As the leader of a respected mercenary company, you should find the terms both fair and equitable.
column2: 议会希望我向你提供一份精选合约，指挥官。作为一支受尊敬的雇佣兵公司的首领，我想你会认为条款既公道又公平。

column1: Maintaining the Republic requires Warriors of Skill and Honor, Commander, and you fit the bill nicely.
column2: 维系共和国需要有本事、有荣誉的战士，指挥官，而你正合适。

column1: Hail Commander.  You have proven to be quite a friend to the Republic. As a result the Council has saved this contract as reward for your services.
column2: 向你致意，指挥官。你已经证明自己是共和国的挚友。因此，议会把这份合约留作对你效力的奖赏。

column1: Honored friend! The Exarch has not forgotten your contributions to the Republic. In light of this, we present you with this choice contract.
column2: 尊敬的朋友！执政官没有忘记你对共和国的贡献。有鉴于此，我们向你奉上这份精选合约。

column1: Holding the Republic together is hard work, mercerary; we don't have time to hold your hand through contracts like this one. Don't fail us again.
column2: 维系共和国很难，雇佣兵；我们没时间在这种合约上手把手照顾你。别再让我们失望。

column1: You consistently let us down, Commander, but desperate times call for desperate measures. Prove your worth on this contract, or don't bother returning.
column2: 指挥官，你一次又一次让我们失望，但危急时刻需要非常手段。在这份合约中证明你的价值，否则就别回来。

column1: The Barrens is a land of resourceful survivors, and your skills, though mercenary, have value here. This job should align with your particular talents, Commander.
column2: 荒原是一个由机敏求生者组成的土地。你的雇佣兵技能虽带有逐利性质，在这里仍有价值。这份工作应该符合你的专长，指挥官。

column1: The Republic has decided to offer you this contract. The terms are straightforward, the pay fair, and it's within your skill set. Do not disappoint us.
column2: 共和国决定向你提供这份合约。条款直截了当，报酬公道，也在你的能力范围内。别让我们失望。

column1: Greetings, Commander. The Republic appreciates consistent partnerships, and we would like to extend this offer to you first. Success will only strengthen the trust we are building.
column2: 你好，指挥官。共和国珍视稳定的合作关系，因此想优先向你提出这份邀约。成功只会进一步巩固我们正在建立的信任。

column1: You have shown the grit and determination needed to support the Republic's vision. Take up this contract and show why you have earned our trust.
column2: 你展现了支持共和国愿景所需的坚韧与决心。接下这份合约，证明你为何值得我们的信任。

column1: Hail, Commander. Your loyalty and efforts have served the Republic well. In recognition, we have a new opportunity for you, one that benefits us all.
column2: 向你致意，指挥官。你的忠诚与努力一直很好地服务于共和国。为此，我们有一项惠及各方的新机会给你。

column1: Trusted friend! The Republic has personally requested this contract be presented to you as recognition for your continued dedication to the Republic's survival and prosperity.
column2: 值得信赖的朋友！共和国特意要求把这份合约交给你，以表彰你持续为共和国的生存与繁荣所作的投入。

column1: Outstanding work, Commander! The Republic of the Barrens thrives because of efforts like yours. Your payment has been sent.
column2: 出色的工作，指挥官！荒原共和国因你这样的努力而兴盛。你的报酬已经发出。

column1: We see you tried, Commander. Partial success isn't ideal, but we will provide compensation for your efforts. Learn from this and do better next time.
column2: 我们看到了你的努力，指挥官。部分成功并不理想，但我们会为你的付出提供补偿。从中吸取教训，下次做得更好。

column1: Your performance was unacceptable, Commander. The Republic has no room for incompetence. Do not return unless you aim to do better.
column2: 你的表现不可接受，指挥官。共和国容不下无能之辈。除非你打算做得更好，否则别回来。

column1: I wouldn't turn to you unless I had no other option. Well, I have no other option. Do this, if you care, and maybe we'll talk pay.
column2: 如果不是走投无路，我不会来找你。可我确实已经别无选择。要是你还在乎，就把这件事办了，也许我们再谈报酬。

column1: We don't like you, you don't like us, but still, I think we can do business. Want to change that?
column2: 我们不喜欢你，你也不喜欢我们，但我想我们还是能做成生意。想改变这种关系吗？

column1: Hello again, Commander. You need money, we need work done, take a look at this contract.
column2: 指挥官，又见面了。你需要钱，我们需要有人办事，看看这份合约吧。

column1: The Rim Collection is in need of some supplemental mercenaries and we've heard you're competent. Care to take a look?.
column2: 边疆联盟需要补充一些雇佣兵，我们听说你能力不错。要不要看看这份合约？

column1: We've got a good thing going here, Commander, let's keep the roll going. Take a gander at this contract, I think you'll find it satisfactory.
column2: 指挥官，我们现在合作得不错，继续保持下去吧。看看这份合约，我想你会满意。

column1: Commander, the Rim has need of you again. We've got a great contract for you and hope you can take care of it for us. The compensation is good, like always.
column2: 指挥官，边疆地区再次需要你。我们有份很好的合约，希望你能替我们处理妥当。报酬一如既往地丰厚。

column1: We count on you like we count on Able's Aces, Commander, you're one of our own at this point. Do this contract and rewards will flow like always.
column2: 指挥官，我们依赖你就像依赖艾布尔王牌一样；你现在已经是我们自己人了。完成这份合约，奖励会像往常一样滚滚而来。

column1: Great show, Commander! The Rim is very pleased with your efforts. I've remitted payment, you should receive it shortly, and don't forget to come around again sometime.
column2: 表现精彩，指挥官！边疆联盟对你的努力非常满意。我已经汇出报酬，你很快就能收到。别忘了以后再来看看。

column1: You gave it a solid try there, Commander. You didn't get it done, but you did your damndest. Sometimes it doesn't work out. Thanks for the effort at least.
column2: 你已经认真尝试过了，指挥官。虽然没能完成，但你确实尽了全力。有时事情就是不会顺利。至少，感谢你的努力。

column1: Commander, this effort is embarrassing for both of us. Don't bother contacting us for payment, it's not coming. Do better next time.
column2: 指挥官，这次表现让我们双方都尴尬。别来联系报酬了，不会有的。下次做得好一点。

column1: I don't know why we bother offering you contracts, to be perfectly honest. It's obvious you're not a friend to the Rim Commonality. Regardless, we find ourselves in desperate times, so we have to scrape the bottom of the barrel.
column2: 说实话，我不知道我们何必费心给你合约。显然，你不是边疆共同体的朋友。尽管如此，我们眼下处境艰难，只能到桶底去刮渣了。

column1: The Rim Commonality has a use for mercenaries like you, Commander. I think you'll be interested in the attached contract. Hopefully we can come to a mutually beneficial agreement.
column2: 边疆共同体用得上你这样的雇佣兵，指挥官。我想你会对随附的合约感兴趣。希望我们能达成互利协议。

column1: The Rim Commonality would like to offer you a choice contract, Commander. As the leader of a respected mercenary company, you should find the terms both fair and equitable, I think.
column2: 边疆共同体想向你提供一份精选合约，指挥官。作为一支受尊敬的雇佣兵公司的首领，我想你会认为条款既公道又公平。

column1: Commander, I hope this message finds you well. The people of the Rim Commonality would like to extend a contract to you, owing to our respect for your skills. Please consider it carefully.
column2: 指挥官，希望你收到这条消息时一切安好。边疆共同体的人民想把这份合约交给你，这是出于我们对你能力的尊重。请仔细考虑。

column1: Greetings, my friend. This contract is not one we would offer to a lesser mercenary, but you've proven your loyalty, prowess, and dedication to the ideals of the Rim Commonality. I hope you'll accept our offer.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。这份合约不是我们会交给普通雇佣兵的，但你已经证明了自己对边疆共同体理念的忠诚、实力与投入。希望你接受我们的提议。

column1: We both know the score, Commander. The Commonality relies on you like you're one of our own, and you've always been happy to help us out. I hope you can see fit to agree this time as well—this is a job too important for lesser warriors.
column2: 你我都清楚局势，指挥官。共同体把你当作自家人一样倚重，而你也一直乐于相助。希望你这次也能答应——这项任务不是普通战士能够胜任的。

column1: I don't know why we're even talking, Commander. You and your kind aren't exactly popular with the Rim Territories. Still, we're in need of your talents, and desperate times make for strange allies. Take this contract and prove you can be useful.
column2: 指挥官，我不知道我们为什么还要谈。你和你这类人并不受边疆领土欢迎。不过，我们需要你的才能，危急时刻也会造就奇怪的盟友。接下这份合约，证明你能派上用场。

column1: Ah, Commander. Even the lowest merc can serve a purpose. Complete this job, and maybe we'll find some respect for you yet—or at least tolerate your presence.
column2: 啊，指挥官。即使是最低等的佣兵也能发挥作用。完成这项工作，也许我们终会对你产生些许敬意——至少能容忍你的存在。

column1: Commander, your skills might just fit the job we have lined up. The Rim Territories sees an opportunity for profit, and we think you'll appreciate the terms of the deal. Consider this a test of mutual benefit.
column2: 指挥官，你的技能或许正适合我们安排的工作。边疆领土看到了获利机会，我们想你会认可这份交易的条款。把它当作一次互利测试吧。

column1: The Rim Territories have a proposition for you, Commander. You're a respected operator, and we believe this contract will appeal to someone with your reputation for getting results.
column2: 边疆领土有个提议给你，指挥官。你是一名受尊敬的行动者，我们相信凭你追求成果的名声，会对这份合约感兴趣。

column1: Greetings, Commander. The overlords of the Rim Territories have been impressed by your recent exploits. We'd like to offer you this contract in recognition of your effectiveness and potential for cooperation.
column2: 你好，指挥官。边疆领土的领主们对你最近的战绩印象深刻。我们想以此合约肯定你的效率，并探寻合作的可能。

column1: Ah, a familiar face! Commander, you've shown loyalty and an unmatched knack for succeeding where others falter. Here's a contract that reflects the trust and respect you've earned with us. Let's keep the plunder flowing.
column2: 啊，是熟面孔！指挥官，你展现了忠诚，也展现了在别人失败之处取得成功的非凡本领。这份合约体现了我们对你赢得的信任与尊重。让战利品继续流入吧。

column1: Commander, you've become something of an honorary pirate to us. You're reliable, ruthless, and profitable—qualities we value highly. We have another task for you that only someone like you can handle. Let's not disappoint.
column2: 指挥官，你已经算是我们的荣誉海盗了。可靠、狠辣、能赚钱——这些都是我们极其看重的品质。我们还有一项只有你这样的人才能处理的任务。别让我们失望。

column1: Solid work, Commander! You've earned your pay and the respect of the Rim Territories. We'll be sure to send more lucrative work your way soon.
column2: 干得扎实，指挥官！你赢得了报酬，也赢得了边疆领土的尊重。我们很快会把更赚钱的工作交给你。

column1: Commander, you didn't quite get everything done, but at least you showed some backbone. You'll get partial payment this time, but next time, I expect more.
column2: 指挥官，你没能把一切都完成，但至少展现了些骨气。这次会给你部分报酬，不过下次我期待你做得更多。

column1: Pathetic, Commander. You failed the job and wasted our time. If you can't deliver next time, don't bother coming back—we don't have room for failures here in the Rim Territories.
column2: 真可悲，指挥官。你搞砸了工作，还浪费了我们的时间。如果下次不能交付成果，就别回来了——边疆领土容不下失败者。

column1: I don't know why we bother offering you contracts, to be perfectly honest. It's obvious you're not a friend to the Rim Worlds Republic. Regardless, we find ourselves in desperate times, so we have to scrape the bottom of the barrel.
column2: 说实话，我不知道我们何必费心给你合约。显然，你不是边疆世界共和国的朋友。尽管如此，我们眼下处境艰难，只能到桶底去刮渣了。

column1: The Rim Worlds Republic has a use for mercenaries like you, Commander. I think you'll be interested in the attached contract. Hopefully we can come to a mutually beneficial agreement.
column2: 边疆世界共和国用得上你这样的雇佣兵，指挥官。我想你会对随附的合约感兴趣。希望我们能达成互利协议。

column1: The Rim Worlds Republic would like to offer you a choice contract, Commander. As the leader of a respected mercenary company, you should find the terms both fair and equitable, I think.
column2: 边疆世界共和国想向你提供一份精选合约，指挥官。作为一支受尊敬的雇佣兵公司的首领，我想你会认为条款既公道又公平。

column1: Commander, I hope this message finds you well. The people of the Rim Worlds Republic would like to extend a contract to you, owing to our respect for your skills. Please consider it carefully.
column2: 指挥官，希望你收到这条消息时一切安好。边疆世界共和国的人民想把这份合约交给你，这是出于我们对你能力的尊重。请仔细考虑。

column1: Greetings, my friend. This contract is not one we would offer to a lesser mercenary, but you've proven your loyalty, prowess, and dedication to the ideals of the Rim Worlds Republic. I hope you'll accept our offer.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。这份合约不是我们会交给普通雇佣兵的，但你已经证明了自己对边疆世界共和国理念的忠诚、实力与投入。希望你接受我们的提议。

column1: We both know the score, Commander. The Republic relies on you like you're one of our own, and you've always been happy to help us out. I hope you can see fit to agree this time as well—this is a job too important for lesser warriors.
column2: 你我都清楚局势，指挥官。共和国把你当作自家人一样倚重，而你也一直乐于相助。希望你这次也能答应——这项任务不是普通战士能够胜任的。

column1: The Rim Worlds Republic understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 边疆世界共和国明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。即使任务失败，你也已经做得不错。把这当作下一场战斗的又一次教训吧。

column1: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, you and your company, {COMPANY.CompanyName}, have been nothing but a thorn in me side, botching every mission with incompetence and folly that sets me teeth on edge.
column2: 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}，你和{COMPANY.CompanyName}简直是我眼中挥之不去的刺，每次任务都因无能与愚蠢而搞砸，令我怒火中烧。

column1: I must begrudgingly acknowledge, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, that you and {COMPANY.CompanyName} have shown some improvement. Though your early endeavors were lacking, you've managed to salvage a few missions with acceptable results, yet still falling short of the standards befitting a true pirate crew.
column2: 我不得不承认，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}，你和{COMPANY.CompanyName}确实有所进步。尽管早期表现糟糕，你们已经完成了几项尚可的任务，但距离真正海盗船员应有的标准仍有差距。

column1: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, your tactical acumen and the prowess of {COMPANY.CompanyName} have begun to earn my grudging respect. Successfully infiltrating enemy installations and securing valuable resources speak volumes of your growing capabilities.
column2: 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}，你的战术才智和{COMPANY.CompanyName}的实力开始赢得我勉强的尊重。成功渗透敌方设施并夺取宝贵资源，充分证明了你们日益增长的能力。

column1: By the stars, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, you and {COMPANY.CompanyName} have become indispensable to our cause. Your daring raids on military outposts and extraction of critical intelligence display a level of skill and precision that I had not anticipated.
column2: 看在群星的份上，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}，你和{COMPANY.CompanyName}已经成了我们事业不可或缺的一部分。你们大胆袭击军事前哨、提取关键情报，展现出的技能与精准超出了我的预期。

column1: Ahoy, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}! Raise a flag for you and {COMPANY.CompanyName}, for your feats have exceeded all expectations. Your audacious strikes and cunning maneuvers have instilled fear in our enemies' hearts, solidifying our dominance among the stars.
column2: 嘿，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}！为你和{COMPANY.CompanyName}升起旗帜吧，你们的功绩超出了一切预期。大胆的突袭与狡猾的机动令敌人胆寒，也巩固了我们在群星中的霸权。

column1: Avast, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}! your audacity and skill continue to impress, striking fear into even the most formidable adversaries. Together, we forge an indomitable alliance, carving our path to victory among the stars.
column2: 扬帆吧，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}！你的胆识与技艺持续令我赞叹，甚至最强大的敌人也为之恐惧。我们共同打造不可摧毁的联盟，在群星间开辟通往胜利的道路。

column1: Ah, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, my esteemed friend and ally in this cosmic conquest! Your bravery and ingenuity have propelled us to triumph after triumph. Together, we shall reign supreme over the galaxy, a testament to your leadership and prowess.
column2: 啊，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}，我在这场宇宙征服中的挚友与盟友！你的勇敢与机智让我们一次又一次取得胜利。我们将共同统治银河，证明你的领导力与才干。

column1: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, I commend you and {COMPANY.CompanyName} for a resounding success in our latest mission. Your strategic brilliance and unwavering resolve have led us to victory once again. The spoils of our conquest are ours to savor, a testament to your exceptional leadership and the prowess of your mercenaries.
column2: 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}，我赞扬你和{COMPANY.CompanyName}在最近任务中取得的辉煌成功。你的战略天才与坚定意志再次带领我们走向胜利。征服所得的战利品应由我们享用，这正是你卓越领导力和麾下佣兵实力的证明。

column1: Though the winds did not favor us this time, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, I trust in your loyalty and the resolve of {COMPANY.CompanyName}. Even the most seasoned mercenaries face setbacks, but your efforts were commendable. Let this failure fuel our determination to seize victory in the battles to come.
column2: 尽管这次风向不利，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}，我仍相信你对我们的忠诚，也相信{COMPANY.CompanyName}的决心。即使最老练的雇佣兵也会遭遇挫折，但你们的努力值得肯定。让这次失败化为动力，在未来的战斗中夺取胜利。

column1: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, your incompetence has cost us dearly in our latest venture. Your crew's performance leaves much to be desired, and {COMPANY.CompanyName} has proven themselves nothing more than a band of scallywags. Shape up, or find yourselves on the wrong end of an autocannon.
column2: 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}，你在最近行动中的无能让我们损失惨重。你的船员表现糟糕透顶，{COMPANY.CompanyName}证明自己不过是一群乌合之众。振作起来，否则就等着吃自动炮吧。

column1: If it were not for the fact that the necrosia has shown me you can be of service, I would not suffer your presence. Here is a trivial task for you, to prove your worth.
column2: 若不是死灵西亚让我看出你还能派上用场，我根本不会容忍你的存在。这里有一项小任务，证明你的价值吧。

column1: Your dishonorable ways are well known to the Scorpion Empire; however, you might yet be of use. Take this batchall and show me that you can serve the Empire.
column2: 你的不光彩行径在蝎群帝国早已众所周知，不过你或许仍有用处。接下这份Batchall，证明你能为帝国效力。

column1: My Clan has faced you in battle before, and you have proven to be a competent warrior. Take up this batchall, and perhaps we can find common ground.
column2: 我的氏族曾与你交战，你已经证明自己是一名合格的战士。接下这份Batchall，也许我们能找到共同立场。

column1: You remain an unknown to us. Prove your worth on the battlefield through this batchall, and the Scorpion Empire may consider further opportunities for you.
column2: 你对我们而言仍是个未知数。在战场上通过这份Batchall证明自己的价值，蝎群帝国或许会考虑与你进一步合作。

column1: You have assisted the Scorpion Empire in the past, and your efforts have not gone unnoticed. I present you with this batchall as an opportunity to further strengthen our bond.
column2: 你过去曾帮助蝎群帝国，你的努力没有被忽视。我把这份Batchall交给你，作为进一步巩固我们关系的机会。

column1: Hello again, friend of the Scorpion Empire. While our mutual trust grows, we present you with this batchall to confirm your sincerity and commitment.
column2: 你好，蝎群帝国的朋友。我们的相互信任正在增长，因此把这份Batchall交给你，以确认你的诚意与投入。

column1: Greetings, trusted ally. You have proven your value to the Scorpion Empire many times. I have a critical task that I would entrust to no other; perhaps we will even share some necrosia afterward.
column2: 你好，值得信赖的盟友。你多次证明了自己对蝎群帝国的价值。我有一项关键任务，只愿托付给你；也许之后我们还能共享一些死灵西亚。

column1: Well done, Commander. I foresaw your success in this matter and have already transferred your payment as agreed.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。我早就预见你会成功，约定的报酬已经转账。

column1: You clearly lacked the strength to complete all objectives; however, your effort is noted. I will provide partial payment for your partial success. Do better next time.
column2: 显然，你缺乏完成所有目标所需的实力；不过你的努力已被记录。我会为你的部分成功支付部分报酬。下次做得更好。

column1: Your weakness is an embarrassment, and you have failed to honor the terms of the batchall in any significant way. You will receive nothing but my disdain.
column2: 你的软弱令人难堪，你几乎没有履行Batchall的条款。你不会得到任何东西，只有我的鄙夷。

column1: I don't know why we bother offering you contracts, to be perfectly honest. It's obvious you're not a friend to the Star League Defense Force. Regardless, we find ourselves in desperate times, so the wanna be warriors will have to do.
column2: 说实话，我不知道我们何必费心给你合约。显然，你不是星际联盟防卫军的朋友。尽管如此，我们眼下处境艰难，只能让这些冒牌战士顶上。

column1: Greetings, mercenary. Though you are not of the same calibre the SLDF, you may yet serve our interests. Finish this job, and we may change our mind.
column2: 你好，雇佣兵。虽然你的水准比不上星际联盟防卫军，但或许仍能为我们的利益效力。完成这项工作，也许我们会改变看法。

column1: The Star League Defense Force has a use for mercenaries like you, Commander. I think you'll be interested in the attached contract. An agreement would be most beneficial.
column2: 星际联盟防卫军用得上你这样的雇佣兵，指挥官。我想你会对随附的合约感兴趣。达成协议对双方都最有利。

column1: The Star League Defense Force would like to offer you a prime contract, Commander. As the leader of a respected mercenary company, you should find the contract acceptable.
column2: 星际联盟防卫军想向你提供一份优质合约，指挥官。作为一支受尊敬的雇佣兵公司的首领，我想你会接受这份合约。

column1: Commander, I hope this message finds you well. The Star League Defense Force would like to extend a contract to you, as you have proven your worth. Please consider it carefully.
column2: 指挥官，希望你一切安好。星际联盟防卫军想把这份合约交给你，因为你已经证明了自己的价值。请仔细考虑。

column1: Greetings, my friend. This contract is not one we would offer to a lesser mercenary, but you've proven your loyalty, prowess, and dedication to the ideals of the Star League Defense Force. I hope you'll accept our offer.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。这份合约不是我们会交给普通雇佣兵的，但你已经证明了自己对星际联盟防卫军理念的忠诚、实力与投入。希望你接受我们的提议。

column1: We both know the sitrep, Commander. The SLDF relies on you like you're one of our own, and you've always been there to help us out. I hope you can see fit to agree this time as well — this is a job too important for lesser warriors.
column2: 你我都清楚战况，指挥官。星际联盟防卫军把你当作自家人一样倚重，而你也一直愿意相助。希望你这次也能答应——这项任务不是普通战士能够胜任的。

column1: Top-tier work, Commander — The SLDF is most pleased with your results. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 顶级表现，指挥官——星际联盟防卫军对你的成果非常满意。继续保持，我会确保有更多工作交给你。

column1: The Star League Defense Force understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a valiant, yet ineffective effort. We trust you will do better for the next battle.
column2: 星际联盟防卫军明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经英勇作战，只是没有奏效。希望下一场战斗你能做得更好。

column1: Your performance was appalling, Commander. Your efforts on the battlefield warrant a demotion, and are not indicative of the leader of a reknowned mercenary company.
column2: 你的表现糟糕透顶，指挥官。你的战场表现足以让你降级，也完全配不上一个受尊敬的雇佣兵公司首领。

column1: I don't know why we bother offering you contracts, to be perfectly honest. It's obvious you do not share General Kerensky's vision. Regardless, we find ourselves in desperate times, so the wanna be warriors will have to do.
column2: 说实话，我不知道我们何必费心给你合约。显然，你不认同克伦斯基将军的愿景。尽管如此，我们眼下处境艰难，只能让这些冒牌战士顶上。

column2: 你好，雇佣兵。虽然你的水准比不上最初的星际联盟防卫军，但或许仍能为我们的利益效力。完成这项工作，也许我们会改变看法。

column1: General Kerensky has a use for mercenaries like you, Commander. I think you'll be interested in the attached contract. An agreement would be most beneficial.
column2: 克伦斯基将军用得上你这样的雇佣兵，指挥官。我想你会对随附的合约感兴趣。达成协议对双方都最有利。

column1: The Star League-in Exile would like to offer you a prime contract, Commander. As the leader of a respected mercenary company, you should find the contract acceptable.
column2: 流亡星际联盟想向你提供一份优质合约，指挥官。作为一支受尊敬的雇佣兵公司的首领，我想你会接受这份合约。

column1: Commander, I hope this message finds you well. The Star League-in Exile would like to extend a contract to you, as you have proven your worth. Please consider it carefully.
column2: 指挥官，希望你一切安好。流亡星际联盟想把这份合约交给你，因为你已经证明了自己的价值。请仔细考虑。

column2: 你好，我的朋友。这份合约不是我们会交给普通雇佣兵的，但你已经证明了自己对克伦斯基将军理念的忠诚、实力与投入。希望你接受我们的提议。

column1: We both know the sitrep, Commander. The Star League-in Exile relies on you like you're one of our own, and you've always been there to help us out. I hope you can see fit to agree this time as well — this is a job too important for lesser warriors.
column2: 你我都清楚战况，指挥官。流亡星际联盟把你当作自家人一样倚重，而你也一直愿意相助。希望你这次也能答应——这项任务不是普通战士能够胜任的。

column1: Top-tier work, Commander — The General Kerensky himself is most pleased with your results. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 顶级表现，指挥官——克伦斯基本人对你的成果非常满意。继续保持，我会确保有更多工作交给你。

column1: The Star League-in Exile understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a valiant, yet ineffective effort. We trust you will do better for the next battle.
column2: 流亡星际联盟明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经英勇作战，只是没有奏效。希望下一场战斗你能做得更好。

column1: Mercenary, our Intelligence has been watching you and the reports aren't quite favorable; perhaps this... opportunity will work towards redeeming yourself.
column2: 雇佣兵，我们的情报部门一直在监视你，报告并不怎么好看；也许这次……机会能帮助你挽回名声。

column1: Mercenary, it may be more profitbable for your venture to cease your attacks on our cells. May this contract draw your interests elsewhere.
column2: 雇佣兵，停止攻击我们的据点，对你的行动也许更有利可图。希望这份合约能把你的兴趣引向别处。

column1: You've disrupted our activities in the past but we know prowess and opportunity when we see it; perhaps working with us may provide better fortunes for you and yours?
column2: 你过去扰乱过我们的行动，但我们知道如何识别实力与机会；也许与我们合作，能让你和你的人获得更好的命运？

column1: Mercenary, our agents are actively engaged in other theatres of operations. We ask that you do this for us in the name of progress and reason.
column2: 雇佣兵，我们的特工正在其他战区积极行动。请以进步与理性的名义替我们完成这件事。

column1: Mercenary, we may be different peoples but you have proven yourself capable of working with us for the greater good of humanity. Would you be interested in furthering our cause?
column2: 雇佣兵，我们或许属于不同的人群，但你已经证明自己能够为了全人类的更大利益与我们合作。你有兴趣推动我们的事业吗？

column1: Greetings, Friend, your history of working with our Agents has not gone unnoticed. We have an excellent opportunity that would be perfect for you. Would you like to know more?
column2: 你好，朋友。你与我们特工合作的历史没有被忽视。我们有个非常好的机会，很适合你。想了解更多吗？

column1: Greetings, Brother, thanks to your noble efforts, we are making strides in overthrowing the chains of the Warrior Caste. Alas, there is still work to do; will you help us?
column2: 你好，兄弟。多亏你的高尚努力，我们正在逐步挣脱战士阶层加诸的枷锁。可惜还有工作要做；你愿意帮忙吗？

column1: Well done, Commander, we look forward to your detailed reports.
column2: 干得好，指挥官，我们期待你的详细报告。

column1: You may drop some beakers before making progress.
column2: 你可以先丢下几个烧瓶，再继续推进。

column1: You may drop some beakers before making progress; just remember whose beakers you are breaking.
column2: 你可以先丢下几个烧瓶再继续推进；不过记住，打碎的是谁的烧瓶。

column1: You know what I love best about mercenaries? You're willing to wade into battle when it's too dangerous for us to risk our own soldiers. So take the job, MechWarrior—fight and die for money, as is your role.
column2: 你知道我最喜欢雇佣兵哪一点吗？当战斗危险到我们不敢拿自己的士兵冒险时，你们却愿意涉险参战。所以接下这份工作吧，机甲战士——为了钱战斗、为了钱送命，这就是你们的职责。

column1: Your reputation precedes you, Commander. Your talents are always valued by the Lyran Commonwealth—and we reward those we value with money commensurate with their skills and loyalty.
column2: 你的名声早已传开，指挥官。恒星联邦始终重视你的才能——而我们会用与你能力和忠诚相称的金钱回报受重视的人。

column1: My friend! House Steiner sends you wishes of good health and full coffers. Once again, we would like to call upon your services—and as ever, we appreciate your loyalty and will show our gratitude in your pay.
column2: 我的朋友！施泰纳家族祝你身体健康、财库充盈。我们再次想请你效力——一如既往地感谢你的忠诚，并会用报酬表达谢意。

column1: I don't know why we bother offering you contracts, to be perfectly honest. It's obvious you're not a friend to the Duchy of Tamarind-Abbey. Regardless, we find ourselves in desperate times, so we have to scrape the bottom of the barrel.
column2: 说实话，我不知道我们何必费心给你合约。显然，你不是塔玛林-修道院公国的朋友。尽管如此，我们眼下处境艰难，只能到桶底去刮渣了。

column1: The Duchy of Tamarind-Abbey has a use for mercenaries like you, Commander. I think you'll be interested in the attached contract. Hopefully we can come to a mutually beneficial agreement.
column2: 塔玛林-修道院公国用得上你这样的雇佣兵，指挥官。我想你会对随附的合约感兴趣。希望我们能达成互利协议。

column1: The Duchy of Tamarind-Abbey would like to offer you a choice contract, Commander. As the leader of a respected mercenary company, you should find the terms both fair and equitable, I think.
column2: 塔玛林-修道院公国想向你提供一份精选合约，指挥官。作为一支受尊敬的雇佣兵公司的首领，我想你会认为条款既公道又公平。

column1: Commander, I hope this message finds you well. The people of the Duchy of Tamarind-Abbey would like to extend a contract to you, owing to our respect for your skills. Please consider it carefully.
column2: 指挥官，希望你收到这条消息时一切安好。塔玛林-修道院公国的人民想把这份合约交给你，这是出于我们对你能力的尊重。请仔细考虑。

column1: We both know the score, Commander. The Hegemony relies on you like you're one of our own, and you've always been there to help us out. I hope you can see fit to agree this time as well — this is a job too important for lesser warriors.
column2: 你我都清楚局势，指挥官。霸权把你当作自家人一样倚重，而你也一直乐于相助。希望你这次也能答应——这项任务不是普通战士能够胜任的。

column1: Top-tier work, Commander — The Hegemony is most pleased with your results. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 顶级表现，指挥官——霸权对你的成果非常满意。继续保持，我会确保有更多工作交给你。

column1: Commander, you've never served the Republic before, so let's be frank — we're unsure what to expect. Take this contract and show us you're worth the c-bills we'd pay.
column2: 指挥官，你以前从未为共和国效力，所以我们坦率地说——不知道该期待什么。接下这份合约，证明自己配得上我们支付的星币。

column1: Your reputation precedes you across these systems, Commander, even if we haven't worked together yet. The Republic has need of skilled blade-for-hire talent — prove yourself with this job.
column2: 你的名声已经传遍这些星系，指挥官，即使我们还没有合作过。共和国需要有本事的刀客——用这份工作证明自己。

column1: Commander, we've worked with you before and your performance was satisfactory. The Republic extends this new contract with confidence in your abilities — deliver, and our respect grows.
column2: 指挥官，我们过去合作过，你的表现令人满意。共和国满怀信心地把这份新合约交给你——完成它，我们对你的尊重就会增加。

column1: Greetings, Commander. Your prior service to the Republic impressed our Council. We offer you this mission in recognition of proven skill and dependability — another success will further strengthen our ties.
column2: 你好，指挥官。你之前为共和国效力，给我们的议会留下了深刻印象。我们以这项任务认可你已证明的能力与可靠性；再一次成功会进一步巩固我们的关系。

column1: Commander, you are among the premier blades we look to in troubled times. The Republic prefers your company above all others — take this critical mission and uphold your outstanding reputation.
column2: 指挥官，在动荡时期，你是我们寻找的顶尖刀客之一。共和国最愿意与你合作——接下这项关键任务，维护你出色的声誉。
